verdict.text: App registration is immediate in Development Mode, but production access requires meeting strict organization partner criteria (including 250k MAUs) and undergoing an app review that takes up to six weeks.
verdict.label: Inferred
verdict.note: Immediate creation of Development Mode apps is supported by the dashboard setup docs, while Extended Quota Mode requires passing partner requirements and a review process lasting up to six weeks.

hands_on_time.label: Inferred
hands_on_time.note: Registering an app in the dashboard, configuring settings, and adding allowlisted users takes only a few minutes. Filling out partner and extension questionnaires takes additional time.

waiting_time.label: Sourced
waiting_time.quote: This review process can take up to six weeks.

prerequisites.text: The app owner must hold an active Spotify Premium account.
prerequisites.label: Sourced
prerequisites.quote: The app owner must have a Spotify Premium account for apps in development mode to function.

prerequisites.text: Production Extended Quota access requires an established, legally registered business entity (individuals are not eligible) with a company email.
prerequisites.label: Sourced
prerequisites.quote: Please note that as of May 15th 2025, Spotify only accepts applications from organizations (not individuals).

prerequisites.text: Production access requires an active, launched service maintaining at least 250,000 monthly active users (MAUs).
prerequisites.label: Sourced
prerequisites.quote: Maintaining a minimum of active users (at least 250k MAUs)

setup_steps.text: Log in to the Spotify Developer Dashboard at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard using your Spotify account.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Login to the Spotify Developer Dashboard. If necessary, read the latest Developer Terms of Service to complete your account set up.

setup_steps.text: Click on the 'Create an App' button on your dashboard.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: To create an app, go to your Dashboard and click on the Create an App button to open the following dialog box:

setup_steps.text: Enter an App Name and App Description, and accept the Developer Terms of Service.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Enter an App Name and App Description of your choice (they will be displayed to the user on the grant screen), put a tick

setup_steps.text: Open the app's overview page and click on 'Settings' (or 'Edit Settings') to configure your application.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Click on Edit Settings to view and update your app settings.

setup_steps.text: In the 'Redirect URIs' field, enter your application callback URL (for example http://127.0.0.1:8080 or your service callback URI) and save changes.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: In Redirect URIs enter one or more addresses that you want to allowlist with Spotify.

setup_steps.text: Retrieve your Client ID and Client Secret from the app overview/settings page (under 'View client secret') for OAuth configuration.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: The Client ID can be found here. The Client Secret can be found behind the View client secret link.

setup_steps.text: If testing in Development Mode, navigate to the 'Users Management' tab in your app settings and allowlist each test user by entering their name and Spotify email address.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Tap on the Add new user button and enter the name and Spotify email address of the user that you want to enable to

scopes.text: user-read-private: Grants read access to the user's subscription details and account type.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Read access to user’s subscription details (type of user account).

scopes.text: user-read-email: Grants read access to the user's real email address.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Read access to user’s email address.

scopes.text: playlist-read-private: Grants read access to the user's private playlists.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Read access to user's private playlists.

scopes.text: playlist-modify-public and playlist-modify-private: Grants write access to create, modify, or reorder public or private playlists.
scopes.label: Inferred
scopes.note: Derived from the playlist scope definitions in the scopes reference page.

scopes.text: user-modify-playback-state: Grants write access to control playback on Spotify clients and Spotify Connect devices.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Write access to a user’s playback state

scopes.text: user-library-read: Grants read access to check and view saved tracks, albums, and episodes in the user's library.
scopes.label: Sourced
scopes.quote: Read access to a user's library.

limits_before_approval.text: Development Mode apps are strictly limited to at most 5 authenticated Spotify users who must be explicitly allowlisted.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced
limits_before_approval.quote: Up to 5 authenticated Spotify users can use an app that is in development mode

limits_before_approval.text: Non-allowlisted users who authenticate receive a 403 status code on API calls.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced
limits_before_approval.quote: However, API requests with an access token associated to that user and app will receive a 403 status code error.

limits_before_approval.text: Developers are limited to one Development Mode Client ID.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced
limits_before_approval.quote: Developers will be limited to one Development Mode Client ID

limits_before_approval.text: Development Mode requests are constrained by quota buckets across the developer account, returning 429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED when exceeded.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced
limits_before_approval.quote: Spotify's Web API has a quota system that limits the number of requests made through development mode apps that belong to a single developer account.

limits_before_approval.text: Development Mode apps will not function unless the app owner maintains an active Spotify Premium account.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced
limits_before_approval.quote: Development Mode use will require a Spotify Premium account

approval_process.text: Step 1: Submit a Partner Application form from a corporate email address to qualify as an organization.
approval_process.label: Sourced
approval_process.quote: Application must be sent through a company email by using this form.

approval_process.text: Step 2: If the Partner Application is approved, go to Dashboard > App > Settings > 'Quota extension Request' tab.
approval_process.label: Sourced
approval_process.quote: If your Partner Application form is approved, you can ask Spotify to move your app from development mode into extended quota mode.

approval_process.text: Step 3: Complete the 4-step questionnaire detailing your app and use case, then submit.
approval_process.label: Sourced
approval_process.quote: Tell us about your app by filling out the provided questionnaire (4 steps)

approval_process.text: Step 4: Spotify's review team evaluates your app for policy compliance, tests the app, and communicates decisions via email within up to six weeks.
approval_process.label: Sourced
approval_process.quote: The app review team will review the information that you have provided, test out your app and send you feedback by email

likely_blockers.text: Individual developers cannot obtain Extended Quota Mode; applications are accepted only from registered organizations.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: Please note that as of May 15th 2025, Spotify only accepts applications from organizations (not individuals).

likely_blockers.text: Failure to demonstrate at least 250,000 monthly active users (MAUs) on an existing launched service.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: Maintaining a minimum of active users (at least 250k MAUs)

likely_blockers.text: Lack of an active Spotify Premium subscription for the app owner.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: The app owner must have a Spotify Premium account for apps in development mode to function.

likely_blockers.text: Attempting to create multiple Development Mode Client IDs under one developer account.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: Developers will be limited to one Development Mode Client ID

likely_blockers.text: Submitting the partner extension application using a personal email rather than a company domain email.
likely_blockers.label: Sourced
likely_blockers.quote: Application must be sent through a company email by using this form.

agent_can_do: Identify and format the required OAuth scopes for your application use case.
Draft the authorization URL and handle the token exchange implementation (Authorization Code or PKCE flow).
Prepare API requests according to the Web API specification.
you_must_do: Log in to the Spotify Developer Dashboard with a Spotify Premium account.
Register the application and configure the exact Redirect URIs in app settings.
Securely copy and store the Client ID and Client Secret.
Manually add up to 5 tester accounts (name and Spotify email) under User Management for Development Mode testing.
Submit the official organization partner application and quota extension review form if planning to deploy to production.

open_questions.text: What specific quota bucket limits are enforced for Development Mode apps, given Spotify notes they are subject to change without published numeric thresholds?
open_questions.label: Inferred
open_questions.note: Documentation indicates that endpoints are grouped into quota buckets and return 429 when exceeded, but does not state the exact numeric request limits.
